Overview:

Vibescape Is an Inter-College Vibe Coding Event Organized by Macstak – the Tech Society of Mac, Department of Computer Science, Maharaja Agrasen College, University of Delhi.

Event Details:

  • Date: 7 October 2026
  • Time: 11:00 Am Onwards
  • Venue: Maharaja Agrasen College, Vasundhara Enclave, New Delhi, Delhi 110096
  • Participation: Team-Wise / Individual
  • Maximum Team Size: 2 Members

Eligibility:

  • Inter-College Participation Is Allowed.
  • Participants Must Bring Their Valid College Id.
  • Each Team Can Have a Maximum of 2 Members.
  • Team Members Must Remain the Same Throughout All Three Rounds.

Event Format:

The Event Consists of Three Rounds — a Quiz, a Vibe Build Challenge, and The Twist.

Rules:

  • Participants May Use only Claude and Gemini for Ai-Assisted Work.
  • Chat Gpt and All Other Ai Tools Are Strictly Prohibited.
  • Only the Free Versions of Claude and Gemini Are Permitted. Paid, Pro, Max, Advanced or Other Premium Plans/models Are Not Allowed.
  • Participants Must Use the Accounts/i Ds Provided by The Organizers and May Not Log in Using Personal Accounts.
  • Google Search May Be Used for Documentation, Images and Other Non-Ai Resources.
  • Phones and Other Personal Digital Devices Are Not Permitted Inside the Lab.
  • Participants Are Responsible for Managing Their Claude and Gemini Usage Limits. the Organizers Will Not Be Responsible for Usage-Limit Restrictions or Exhaustion.
  • Team Members Must Remain Unchanged Throughout All Three Rounds.
  • Participants Must Bring Their College Id.
